decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch that extends the established range and still has its own page in 2024, it likely meets or is close enough to aspiration levels to remain in the portfolio.
This product is also within the firm’s core construction equipment competence and continued full web presentation suggests acceptable early market performance and strategic fit.
Because it is distant from the established offer and was reduced from a dedicated page to only a mention by 2024, management would read it as falling below aspiration and reallocate resources.
A multi-model line in the firm’s core area with dedicated presentation across both years indicates commitment, organizational support and results likely above the threshold for continuation.
Although only mentioned on the website after its 2024 launch, it is close to the established offer, so the firm’s slack and learning orientation make near-term retention more likely than withdrawal.
This is a distant 2024 launch and therefore riskier, but its dedicated page suggests the firm is still in a problemistic search and learning phase rather than ready to abandon it immediately.
